subject: MAP: Acme evaluation kit exchange & acceptance cadence
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ryan Hale <ryan@acmelabs.com>, Elena Torres <elena@acmelabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Acme evaluation kit exchange & acceptance cadence

Hi Ryan / Elena —

Thanks again for committing to the short evaluation with Redwood. Per our call today I'm attaching the materials we typically exchange so legal and engineering can review in parallel. Proposed mutual action plan (high level):

- Week 0 (today): Redwood provides evaluation manifest + prompt pack + sample test cases (see attachments).
- Week 1: Acme ingests to sandbox; run 3 smoke prompts and share any immediate quality blockers.
- Week 2: Acceptance window open — Acme executes the MAP testcases (pass/fail + notes).
- Week 3: Joint review of results, sign-off on acceptance criteria or request remediations.

Usage constraints (summary):
- Ephemeral access only (30 days) for the evaluation assets; no external redistribution.
- Testcases and promptpack are escrowed and must be deleted after the acceptance window unless otherwise agreed.
- Redwood will log token-level access for audit; we can provide a redacted audit export on request.

Attachments: acme_eval_manifest.csv (manifest), promptpack_v1.zip (prompt examples + runner), map_acme_draft.pdf (MAP with milestones).

Next steps: Can you confirm the acceptance window (we suggested Sep 14–20) and whether your security team needs an on-call for the ingestion? Ben will follow on pricing/committed capacity for the pilot.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Ryan Hale <ryan@acmelabs.com>

Cc: Elena Torres <elena@acmelabs.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Acme evaluation kit exchange & acceptance cadence

Marissa —

Got the materials, thanks. Quick questions from our side:

1) Retention: the MAP says 30 days — we need to confirm our legal team is comfortable with temporary storage in our sandbox; will Redwood provide a certified deletion logfile when you take the assets back?
2) Sensitive examples: a few promptpack examples look like they include PII-like placeholders. Can we get a sanitized variant if necessary?

Elena and I are broadly fine with the Sep 14–20 window; we'll confirm by EOD today after Acme's security review.

Also, can Ben weigh in on whether the pilot includes a small reserved slot (1 GPU) or is entirely hosted burst? That will affect our acceptance criteria throughput.

—Ryan
Ryan Hale
Head of Applied ML | Acme Labs
ryan@acmelabs.com

Ryan —

Quick commercial note: for the pilot we can offer a one-week reserved slot (small instance) for the acceptance window at a heavily discounted pilot rate. That gives you predictable throughput for the MAP tests while keeping cost exposure low. If you prefer hosted burst we can still proceed but the acceptance criteria will be throughput-agnostic (quality-only).

I've linked the hubspot deal for visibility: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8250/ACME-2026-042. If you confirm the reserved slot I'll add the pilot SKUs and a short SOW to the DocuSign envelope.

Ben Carter

Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Acme evaluation kit exchange & acceptance cadence — redlines

Team / Ryan —

Attached are a few redlines and clarifying language we recommend for the MAP to ensure auditability and limited-use obligations are explicit:

- Add a certified deletion clause with date/time and hash of deleted artifact list to be produced within 5 business days of deletion.
- Explicitly restrict training use (no model retraining or derivative datasets).
- Clarify that promptpack examples that include realistic PII must be replaced with syntactic placeholders before delivery; Redwood will provide an annotated sanitized promptpack if requested.

Attachment: redlines_olga.pdf (summary of legal changes).

If Acme is comfortable we can bake these into the MAP and issue a DocuSign for signature (short-form SLA annex).

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Acme evaluation kit exchange & acceptance cadence — next steps

Ryan / Elena —

Thanks for the quick review. Summary / action items:

- Redwood will provide a sanitized promptpack (promptpack_v1_sanitized.zip) before ingestion.
- Legal redlines accepted in principle; we'll incorporate Olga's deletion language and the training prohibition into the MAP.
- Ben to confirm reserved slot pricing; Marissa to push updated MAP PDF and DocuSign envelope by Monday morning.
- Acme to confirm acceptance window (we still recommend Sep 14–20) and provide sandbox contact for access.

I'll attach the updated MAP draft once Olga's language is merged. For traceability we'll include the manifest hash in the envelope and the deletion logfile after the 30-day period.

Marissa
